title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Defeat and a New Dream

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is unable to win the spring Tenno Sho, but she praises the other runners and resolves to win next time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen. The next morning, on her way to some independent training, Matikanetannhauser spots Mejiro McQueen running hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's deeply impressed, watching McQueen channel her disappointment from the spring Tenno Sho into preparation for the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The medium-distance G1 Takarazuka Kinen is two months away. We need to put everything we've got into training if we're going to win!
